name: A Week On The Water
source:
Four beautiful girls, warm weather and a million-dollar yacht. Is this paradise?

Week On The Water is a light-hearted, flirty and sexy comedy with a warm beat and rhythm. Join Dee Dee, Nettie, Amelia and Lorin as they look forward to a week of pure relaxation, good food, and a luxury yacht all to themselves. 

... But is all of that really as good as it sounds?

[From [url=https://digitallydownld.itch.io/a-week-on-the-water-demo-version]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
四位娇艳迷人的女孩、温暖宜人的晴朗天气，外加一艘价值百万美元的豪华游艇。这里莫非就是人间天堂？

《A Week On The Water》是一部节奏明快温暖、轻松俏皮又香艳撩人的喜剧视觉小说。跟随蒂蒂、内蒂、艾米莉亚与洛琳一同登船吧，她们正满心期待着在独属于她们的豪华游艇上度过整整一周纯粹放松、美食相伴的惬意假期。

……只是，这一切真的像听起来那么美好吗？

[摘自[url=https://digitallydownld.itch.io/a-week-on-the-water-demo-version]itch.io[/url]]
